nolviko.ads.title: Ads
nolviko.ads.label: Advertisement
nolviko.ads.reauth: Confirm your password first; changing ads needs a confirmation from the last 15 minutes.
nolviko.ads.error_failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
nolviko.ads.none_help: Add an ad, choose where it appears and who sees it. For Google AdSense, paste the ad unit code and turn on the AdSense option in Settings.
nolviko.ads.name: Name
nolviko.ads.clicks_note: Clicks are counted for image and text ads; ad networks report their own numbers.
nolviko.ads.position_head: Page head (AdSense Auto ads, verification code)
nolviko.ads.position_help: For the places between forums, threads and posts the number below says after which row the ad appears.
nolviko.ads.audience_help: Groups with the permission "Hide ads" never see ads (for example supporters).
nolviko.ads.field_repeat: Repeat: every that many rows / posts
nolviko.ads.code_help: Paste the code from your ad network. Script tags get the page's security nonce automatically.
nolviko.ads.field_weight: Weight (1-10) when several ads share a place
nolviko.ads.ads_txt_help: Served at /ads.txt. Your ad network tells you the lines to add (for AdSense: google.com, pub-..., DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0).
nolviko.ads.adsense_help: Adds Google's ad hosts to the Content-Security-Policy, so AdSense code can load.
nolviko.ads.field_hosts: Other ad network hosts (one per line)
nolviko.ads.hosts_help: Addresses like https://ads.example.com or https://*.example.net that your ad code loads from.
nolviko.ads.field_excluded: No ads on these pages (address beginnings, one per line)
nolviko.ads.excluded_help: Sign-in, registration, account, private messages and the admin area never show ads (AdSense does not allow ads on pages without content).
nolviko.ads.hide_help: To hide ads for a group, give it the permission "nolviko.ads.hide" in Admin > User groups.
